name: @sauce/oracle
description: SauceScript's oracle requests: a program asks a Chainlink CRE workflow for an off-chain result, and its `.then` runs on the same Private Pot when the workflow's report arrives through Chainlink's KeystoneForwarder. `Oracle.cre({ owner, args })` logs the request and parks the body as a promise bound to the workflow's owner; `onReport` is the handler a report lands on, and the Pot declares `IReceiver` (0x805f2132) for the forwarder's ERC-165 check. Built on `@sauce/async`. `main` names the NEUTRAL BASE the compiler suffixes per target (oracle.evm.js); there is no SVM arm, because the handlers a report lands on are a Private Pot's Router's.
